name: lumiiq
description: LumiIQ is a web-based, state-of-the-art eye-gaze assistive technology for paralyzed, bed-ridden, or locked-in patients. It runs in any modern browser using a standard webcam — no special hardware — and is now backed by a **proper Python server with a real SQLite database and a JSON REST API**.

scripts.test: node gaze/test_gaze.js && node gaze/_smoke.js && node --test tests/*.test.js gaze/test_drift.js gaze/test_confidence.js
